pairingNote: The hubs SEDM's two facets pair with, as DATA, so the bridging code names no hub (nextStandards-102326 wave 2, lane G; DESIGN-G0-sedm-102426.md §7-8; BRONZE_CROWN ruling 3, 2026-10-24, option A). The DECLARED-IDENTITY facet ('') pairs with the CEDS hub only and takes its stableIdTemplate rules ('fromHubStableIdTemplateRules': the CEDS list opens with a memberByNotation rule for its CTDL seam, which declared identity does not admit). The JUDGED facet ('Element') pairs with the CTDL hub only.
declaredIdentifierFormNote: PROVENANCE: the CSV's own column header 'Global ID (CEDS)' (sheet 6, 'CEDS Map', of SEDM Logical Model and Maps; forges/sedm snapshot 01) says each cell is a CEDS element's Global ID. The forge carries the cell verbatim as globalIdText; this file states how such a cell is written as the CURIE the CEDS hub's term rules resolve (the hub's rule ^ceds:(P\d{6})$, its property term): six digits d -> ceds:Pd. A cell the pattern does not match is refused by name, save the declared absent sentinels (an empty cell; 'Proposed', the working group's word for an element CEDS does not yet have). The bare form ceds:<six digits> is NOT used: the hub resolves it to a CLASS term, the CTDL seam's form, and a SEDM element is never mapped to a class card (BRONZE_CROWN ruling 3).

verifiedBy.note: the SEDM working group's address, HTTP 200 by curl -L on 2026-10-24 (it redirects to a Google Doc titled 'CEDS-SEDM.org'). The working group's CEDS Map sheet (forges/sedm snapshot 01, working documents, no published version) names, per element, the CEDS element it annotates in its 'Global ID (CEDS)' column; that column is read verbatim.
